:= by
  have : ∀ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i := by
    intro i
    rw [add_le_add_iff_left]
    exact le_supr f i
  let s : Set G := Set.range f
  have h : BddAbove s := hf
  have h' : BddAbove (a +ˢ s) :=
    by
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
      refine ⟨a + u, _⟩
      rw [le_add_iff]
      exact hu
  constructor
  · rw [supr_add]
    exact h'
  · rw [add_supr]
    exact h
